deadEnds.why: PEP 668 externally-managed-environment refusal. Worked around with a local venv at asset-library/.../objaverse/.venv (objaverse 0.1.7 + trimesh 5.1.0 installed there); the HuggingFace direct path also works with no package at all.

Zero true split-flap or LED departure boards exist. Cap3D matched 29 caption hits for 'departure board|arrival board|split-flap|timetable board' but only 2 of those uids are inside Objaverse 1.0, and both are student exhibition podiums (rejected). Widening to 'display board|notice board|digital signage|led display' returned 162 hits, all noticeboards, chalkboards or exhibition panels. Acquired 5 flat digital-signage/LED-panel carriers as proxies instead.
Returns 404 for the crawled uids (models delisted since the 2023 Objaverse crawl). Thumbnails were taken from the archived metadata shards instead, which still resolve on media.sketchfab.com.

deadEnds.source: media.sketchfab.com thumbnails for 17 of 207 acquired uids
deadEnds.why: S3 AccessDenied at every offered resolution - those source models are no longer public. The GLBs themselves are still served by HuggingFace. Those 17 were verified structurally from their glTF node/material names instead of visually (list in thumbs_unavailable.json).

pyglet<2 raises AttributeError: 'CocoaAlternateEventLoop' object has no attribute 'platform_event_loop' on macOS 25.5 arm64; no EGL/OSMesa path on Darwin. Replaced with (a) the original Sketchfab thumbnails and (b) glTF node/material name inspection, which is stronger evidence of what the geometry actually is.

Not used for downloads. Its GLB hosting is split across GitHub/Thingiverse/Smithsonian mirrors with far worse metadata; Objaverse 1.0 alone satisfied every category except departure board, and Cap3D coverage (1.6M rows) already spans XL uids for search purposes - the XL-only hits were checked and none were station fixtures we lacked.

topPicks: turnstile/19a605237d7e4b06a5fbb4bd5946f2b2 - 'Animated Ticket Gate', glTF nodes ticketGate1/ticketGateMain1/frontDoor1/backDoor1: a real paired fare gate with animatable flap doors. Best single turnstile in the lane.
turnstile/150c6cd064db4d61aebf50e0e17c562e - '3 Ticket Gates', 5,034 tris: a ready-made bank of three modern fare gates with lit indicator panels, drop straight into the paid-area boundary.
turnstile/0973dbf7a3... - 'Metro Station Environment', 56,590 tris: vending machines + ticket turnstiles + ATM in one coherent metro kit; useful as a layout reference for the whole 2F ticket hall.
ticket_machine/8c2d3e303d4b4953bc96ccb9005456d9 - 'San Francisco BART Clipper Card Machine', 80,617 tris: a genuine transit ticket vending machine, the closest match to a KORAIL self-service kiosk.
ticket_machine/94a9a30168... - 'BWegt Fahrscheinautomat': German rail ticket vending machine, correct proportions and screen/keypad/slot layout for re-skinning to KORAIL.
ticket_machine/bc874afd2e6c4bf59477c6dd04b54a92 - 'Vending machine 9 (for train ticket)', 190,881 tris: paired train-ticket machines under a transit map; over 100k tris, decimate before use.
escalator/d1e9d7e1b8... - 'Escalator / KONE TravelMaster 110': a named real-world commercial escalator model, correct balustrade and comb-plate proportions.
escalator/da1997bf0a... - 'Escalator': clean low-poly escalator with side panels and rounded handrails, the cheapest drop-in for the 30-degree runs.
escalator/8b49e571972245ea8b4a781a73dfa5fd - 'ESKLT', 734,309 tris: highest-fidelity escalator available; far over the 10k interior budget, use as a decimation source or hero-shot asset only.
bench/e7c90c3d... + bench/c0951700... + bench/7467fd6d... - low-poly slatted benches under 2k tris each, the correct weight class for concourse and platform seating.
station_scene/735a0bc9e0544443addc5b3965c1e18b - 'Waiting Room Chairs': a four-seat connected gang chair row, exactly the fixture type used in Korean station waiting halls.

station_scene/45fe80d3dd69401791c1ca2295372ac0 + a272abeeb0174607ad8a61a1ce588d38 - Japanese electronic-payment coin locker banks (one is a photogrammetry scan of Ueno Station's park exit); the nearest real-world analogue to KORAIL coin lockers.

notes.unityImport: Unity 6000.3.23f1 has no built-in .glb importer. All 207 files import through the official Unity package com.unity.cloud.gltfast (glTFast), which supports glTF 2.0 / GLB with embedded PBR textures; that is why unityImportable is true. Without glTFast installed, convert to FBX first. Main agent owns the import step.
notes.polygonBudget: 159 of 207 files are at or under the 10,000-triangle interior target; 18 exceed 100,000 triangles and are flagged individually in 'what'.
notes.verification: Every file was re-hashed and size-checked on disk after download. 190 of 207 were visually confirmed against their original Sketchfab thumbnails (contact sheets in .../objaverse/contact/*.png); the remaining 17 have dead thumbnail CDN entries and were confirmed instead by reading their glTF node and material names. 13 further downloads were rejected outright and are listed with per-item evidence in .../objaverse/rejected.json.
